name: Yahoo Mail
author: OpenOptOut
description: Yahoo Mail email provider. The person signs in with Yahoo (OAuth 2.0); mail is sent over Yahoo's SMTP and read over its IMAP with that sign-in token (SASL OAUTHBEARER). No app passwords. Reads confirmation links from message bodies without marking them read. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects for hidden recipients and enforces the recipient at send time.
